name: bbookkeeppeerr
description: Bookkeeping and accounting system for businesses

scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.test:backend: cd backend && uv venv && uv sync && uv run pytest -v
